question.text: Sovereign Wealth Funds (SWFs) have invested in Indian AIF market primarily from:

answer.text: Countries with trade surpluses: OPEC nations, Canada, Mauritius, EU, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.1.1, SWFs from OPEC, Canada, Mauritius, EU, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia have invested in Indian AIFs. The Trap: Narrow geographies miss key SWF origin countries. Cross-Exam Context: Important investor ecosystem context. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track SWF capital flow trends — leading indicator for emerging-market AIF demand.
